title: SeasonHud Tweaks
description: Some tweaks and improvements for SeasonHud mod!
body:
![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2b7d7ddfb6725a683aded84be588192112d2955.png)

An add-on for Serene Seasons and SeasonHud mods, that's added some features in the game.

It's mod created for [Endless Rise: Remastered](https://github.com/BMProjects-Development/Endless-Rise-Remastered) modpack and added some features for better gameplay in modpack. 

Currently mod has only one feature - show hud from SeasonHud mod only if player has a calendar in your inventory, off-hand or curios slot.

# Features:
- Now, the Hud from the SeasonHud shows only if you have a calendar in your inventory or a Curios slot.
- More features will be added in future updates!

# FAQ:
Q: Can I use this mod in my projects?

A: Yes, of course! 


Q: You are planned for new updates for mod in the future?

A: In next updates we want to add some new features for better gameplay in our modpack. 


Q: Can I write a ideas for new updates?

A: Yeah, if you has a idea - just write us on Discord or GitHub for example!
